'''KR-82 Expulser''' was a [[Tank Buster droid]] that served as the center of the [[Kaon]]'s automated security system artificial intelligence. During the [[Rakghoul]] [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] on Kaon the droid motherboard got corrupted by the virus and was destroyed to restore the system to order.<ref name="SWTOR" />
